message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.beach_only: No echo comes back here. The island only comes to the east shore beyond the capital.
message.skyabyss.weathercock.peak_only: The weathercock will not turn. The thunder wing only comes down on the peak west of the capital.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.bas: The warm stone stays cold. The ember only surfaces in the ash land south of the capital.
